capture.command: Same Debian 12 file server as samba-samba-4.17.12 (/etc/exports: /srv/nfs/home 192.168.112.0/20(rw,...) lab-app01(rw,...); /srv/nfs/backup lab-backup01(ro,no_root_squash,...)); apt-get install netbase; rpcbind -w; rpc.mountd -p 20048 -N 2 -V 3 (the kernel nfsd module is not loadable in the lab VM, so only the userland MOUNT service ran; it answers EXPORT from the export table). Ports reached through a socat forwarder container on the lab network; the real nas collector binary (options mode=nfs, portmapPort) called rpcbind GETPORT and MOUNT v3 EXPORT through a TCP recording proxy that wrote each direction of each connection verbatim.
